docs.title: PrivaLens - Automated Web Privacy & Regulatory Compliance Scanner
docs.text:
Author(s): * Naman Arora (Roll No: 1024160029) * Prabhrajwin Singh (Roll No: 1024160024) * Ishmanjot Singh (Roll No: 1024160016)

Lab Instructor: Jeelani Asif

docs.title: Project Overview
docs.text: PrivaLens is an automated privacy and regulatory compliance scanner that bridges legal promises with actual runtime technical behavior. It navigates a target website using a headless browser, intercepts network requests to identify third-party trackers or PII (Personally Identifiable Information) leaks, and uses Natural Language Processing (NLP) to audit the website's privacy policy text for mismatches or discrepancies under regulations like the EU GDPR and India's DPDP Act 2023.

docs.title: System Architecture
docs.text: PrivaLens uses a decoupled 3-tier architecture: 1. Frontend Dashboard (Next.js / React): Submission portal and interactive compliance scorecards. 2. Headless Crawler & Queue (Node.js + Puppeteer + Redis / Bull): Headless browser environment executing scans and intercepting dynamic telemetry. 3. NLP Engine & Storage (Python + SpaCy + PostgreSQL): Natural language parsing of policy clauses, discrepancy cross-examination, and historical scan storage.

docs.text:
To run the project locally: 

# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/namanarora-29/ucs503p-202627-privalens.git

# Follow installation steps in /code

docs.title: Weekly Progress Journal — Ishmanjot Singh (Roll No: 1024160016)
docs.text: Project Name: PrivaLens (Automated Privacy & Regulatory Compliance Scanner) Role: ML & NLP Policy Parser Lead, Legal Compliance Researcher

docs.title: Week 1 (Aug 3 - Aug 9): Privacy Regulations & DPDP Act Research
docs.text:
• Participated in group brainstorming sessions for project selection.
  • Researched legal compliance standards under GDPR and India's DPDP Act 2023 to map out scanning rules.

docs.title: Week 2 (Aug 10 - Aug 16): NLP Pipeline Feasibility
docs.text:
• Researched methods to analyze privacy policy text using Machine Learning.
  • Investigated NLP frameworks (SpaCy) and text classifiers to evaluate parsing and paragraph classification rules.

docs.title: Week 3 (Aug 17 - Aug 23): Proposal Text Drafting
docs.text:
• Drafted sections on Problem Statement, Project Scope, and Evaluation Metrics in the LaTeX project proposal.
  • Formulated the theoretical logic for the discrepancy matrix (cross-referencing legal statements against network tracking beacons).

docs.title: Week 4 (Aug 24 - Aug 30): Document Review & Proofreading
docs.text:
• Collaborated on proofreading the proposal deck and LaTeX files.
  • Assisted in checking code blocks and compiling DFD and Use Case diagrams.
  • Cleaned up document formatting and adjusted author metadata under instructor instructions.

docs.title: Week 5 (Aug 31 - Sep 6): Legal Clause Taxonomy & Discrepancy Matrix Formulation
docs.text:
• Defined the formal classification taxonomy for privacy policies, mapping legal clauses to GDPR Articles 6/12/32 and DPDP Act 2023 Sections 5/8/16.
  • Formulated the penalty deduction weights and scoring criteria for the automated Compliance Health Score (0–100 scale).
  • Coordinated with the team to align Gantt milestone deadlines with regulatory research targets.

docs.title: Week 6 (Sep 7 - Sep 13): NLP Policy Classification Engine & Test Suite Development
docs.text:
• Implemented the rule-based NLP policy extraction and paragraph segmentation engine (nlpParser.js).
  • Coded automated intent taggers identifying restrictive promises (e.g. "no third-party ad tracking", "strictly essential cookies") vs permissive claims.
  • Developed the 3 preloaded real-world demonstration datasets (E-Commerce Ad Tracker Mismatch, Healthcare PII Exfiltration, and GDPR-Compliant SaaS) for the live prototype demo.

docs.title: Weekly Progress Journal — Prabhrajwin Singh (Roll No: 1024160024)
docs.text: Project Name: PrivaLens (Automated Privacy & Regulatory Compliance Scanner) Role: Backend & Crawler Lead, System Architect & DFD Designer

docs.title: Week 1 (Aug 3 - Aug 9): Dynamic Web Scraping Research
docs.text:
• Participated in brainstorming and project selection meetings.
  • Researched dynamic crawling methods and evaluated the feasibility of using headless browser instances (Puppeteer) to catch tracking cookies and network beacons.

docs.title: Week 2 (Aug 10 - Aug 16): Backend Architecture Definition
docs.text:
• Designed the system's structural architecture, outlining a three-tier model: a Next.js frontend, an Express/Node.js crawler API with a Redis task queue, and a Python FastAPI backend for NLP parsing.
  • Drafted database schemas for recording cookie data and compliance logs.

docs.title: Week 3 (Aug 17 - Aug 23): Slide Deck & Proposal Contributions
docs.text:
• Wrote the backend system description and tech stack justifications for the project slide deck.
  • Contributed backend architecture sections to the LaTeX project proposal report.

docs.title: Week 4 (Aug 24 - Aug 30): LaTeX Data Flow Diagram (DFD) Creation
docs.text:
• Coded and compiled the standalone Data Flow Diagrams (project-proposal/dfd.tex) in LaTeX using TikZ.
  • Designed three structural layouts:
  • Level 0 (Context): User/Admin boundaries.
  • Level 1 (Process Detail): Visualizing input, crawling, parsing, scoring, and databases.
  • Level 2 (Sub-Process Detail): Detailing request matching logic.
  • Managed coordinate mapping and curved arrows to ensure a zero-overlap, readable layout.

docs.title: Week 5 (Aug 31 - Sep 6): Relational DB Modeling & Diagram Verification
docs.text:
• Designed the PostgreSQL relational database schema for storing scan audits, tracking beacon logs, cookie attributes, and discrepancy records.
  • Verified and refined the Level 1 and Level 2 TikZ Data Flow Diagram coordinate anchors alongside Naman.
  • Defined microservice communication contracts between the crawler sniffer and the discrepancy matching engine.

docs.title: Week 6 (Sep 7 - Sep 13): Headless Sniffer & Real-Time PII Exfiltration Detection Engine
docs.text:
• Developed the Node.js network sniffer module capable of live HTTP fetching, script tag extraction, and DOM network inspection.
  • Built the known third-party tracker identification database (Google Analytics, Meta/Facebook Pixel, Criteo, Hotjar, TikTok, DoubleClick, etc.).
  • Implemented the dynamic PII leak detector using regex pattern matching across URL query parameters and headers (catching exposed emails, phone numbers, auth tokens, and healthcare telemetry).

docs.title: Week 6 (Sep 7 - Sep 13): Full-Stack Prototype Implementation & Mid-Evaluation Demonstration
docs.text:

  • Engineered the interactive Compliance Scorecard (circular health gauge, letter grade, and KPI metric cards), Discrepancy Matrix View (side-by-side policy vs reality mismatch inspection), and one-click printable PDF audit report generator.
  • Integrated the Express REST API with the frontend client and set up local execution environments for seamless demonstration.
